full_judgment: 46. In this sub-continent Constitution of India is the earliest one after the partition and independence of the Indian Sub-continent in 1947 from British rule and the same came into operation on the 26th day of January, 1950. Then came the first Constitution of Pakistan in 1956 and then another Constitution in 1962 after the abrogation of the earlier one by the martial law authorities in October, 1958. After the Constitution of Bangladesh came into operation in 1972 another Constitution came into operation in 1973 in Pakistan.
